purpose: Editable translation drafts for the Soundwise 20-second homepage video; the website route registry chooses the published languages.
reviewStatus: All translated headlines and captions remain drafts without native-speaker approval. Automated and visual review of the 14 website translations passed at deployment; Urdu remains an unpublished draft.
renderingNotes: Preserve the English brand, example words and IPA. Do not translate sheep or ship.
Use each locale direction for prose. Isolate Soundwise English, English words and IPA as LTR spans inside RTL text.
The app combines Hindi/Urdu; these assets separate its bilingual strings into Hindi and Urdu variants before substituting phonemes.
Chinese uses the app Simplified Chinese copy; Cantonese uses Traditional Chinese and colloquial Cantonese.
The current Public Sans assets do not cover every script. Use fonts with appropriate script coverage and shaping before rendering.
Fit line breaks and reading holds per language; do not assume the English 20-second layout works unchanged.
